datasets.title: Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars (USGS SIM 3464) - GIS database
datasets.mission: Compiled from orbital data (CTX, HiRISE, CRISM, THEMIS and others)
datasets.producer: USGS / JPL (Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M.)
datasets.citation: Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M., 2020, Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map 3464, pamphlet 14 p., 1 sheet, scale 1:75,000, https://doi.org/10.3133/sim3464
datasets.known_limitation: USGS metadata: 'This map was created on a semi-controlled CTX mosaic prior to the release of the controlled CTX mosaic ... will have random offsets of about 100-200 meters from the surface operations CTX mosaic.'
